body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics presented ‘K3’, its 0.27-inches thick stylish MP3 player with 1.8-inch OLED screen during CES 2007, which is the slimmest mp3 player of its product lineup. While sharing the same interface and features with K5, the K3 has a unique feature with a separate detachable external speaker, thereby keeping itself slimmer and lightweight. So, users can share music with powerful sound from the speaker and they can also leave it at home to increase portability.
The K3 features up to 25 hours of battery life and comes in models with 2GB, 4GB or 8GB of flash memory. It will be available in March 2007.
